comparison.objective: Hang two wine glasses upside down in an overhead channel rack.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-stem grasping, end-threading into a channel, overhead sliding, and fragile release.
comparison.success_condition: Both feet rest on the rack lips, stems are centered, tilt is at most 5 degrees, hands are clear, and neither glass was tipped past 45 degrees.
comparison.reason: This tests fragile high-reach insertion and hanging, not tool-driven adjustment or measured dynamic commissioning.
